newsitem.title: UK: Gold price rise unlikely while equities flourish.
newsitem.headline: Gold price rise unlikely while equities flourish.

text.p: Gold prices are unlikely to move significantly higher as long as world equity markets remain strongly bullish, Gary Maude executive director of Gencor told Reuters on Thursday.
But prices should find a "tremendously strong" floor at around the $380.00 an ounce level, he said.
"I don't see a fall in the gold price, but we won't see much improvement until people seek refuge in gold again," he said.
"I can't see (gold in) the middle of the $400s before there is trouble in the international financial scene," he added.
